### Introduction
This chapter will introduce the LED status of our M20Hv equipment
### Schematic diagram
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=daf637dd78ebdfc0f74bac332a1477e2)

##### Status description:
· PWR (power indicator) ![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6b6ba3ee4ca51a32b69b2c82212b7f10)
· GPS (positioning indicator)
· REC (recording indicator)
· NET (network indicator)
· WIFI (WIFI function indicator)
PWR: always on and flashing (device is powered on normally), always on (camera video is normal), flashing (video is lost, i.e. the device is not connected to a camera, no camera is connected or the camera settings do not match);
GPS: always on (GPS positioning is successful), flashing (GPS module exists but positioning is not successful), off (GPS module does not exist or GPS module is faulty);
REC: always on (TF card exists, recording), flashing (not recording), off (no storage medium);
NET: always on (device is connected to the network normally and on the platform), flashing (not registered on the platform), off (4G or WiFi module)
WIFI: always on (4G+AP mode), off (4G+WIFI mode)
